edge:edge.message: In its tools/list entry, MCP tool "zod_schema" of MCP server "edge" sends a serialized schema as `annotations` (it has `_def`, `~standard`). Clients drop the fields `ToolAnnotations` doesn't define, so the tool reaches them with no title or safety hints. Its `inputSchema` is empty too, so the tool's real input schema was likely passed as the annotations and never reached clients.
edge:edge.fix: A schema landed where the annotations go. With `server.tool()`, pass the input schema as a raw Zod shape (`{ path: z.string() }`, not `z.object(...)`). With `server.registerTool(name, { inputSchema, annotations }, cb)`, pass a raw shape or a `z.object(...)`: a root `z.union(...)` or `.nullable()` still publishes an empty object schema, so make optional arguments optional fields (`{ path: z.string().optional() }`). Then set `annotations` to `{ title, readOnlyHint: true }` or `{ title, destructiveHint: true }`.

Then set `annotations` to `{ title, readOnlyHint: true }` or `{ title, destructiveHint: true }`.
